messages:
alice: Starting onboarding for new candidate 'skein-embed-6b'. Goals: fp16 baseline, int8 per-channel probe, and an experimental int6 shrink for edge devices. Short smoke + clustering + recall@k.
tom: Please include wiki holdout R@1/10/100, silhouette, and per-category slices (finance/legal/ops). Also short-query (<15 tokens) and multilingual (en/fr/zh).
maya: CI: paste quant commands and calib sizes so infra can reproduce exact artifacts.
alice: Baseline numbers from local runs (wiki holdout): fp16 R@1=0.60 R@10=0.83 R@100=0.93 silhouette=0.42 short-query R@10=0.69. Artifacts pushed to gs://redwood-evals/skein/2026-03-25/runA/
alice: Quant commands:
```bash
# per-channel int8
python eval/quantize.py --model skein-embed-6b --quant per_channel --bits 8 --calib 4096 --out /tmp/skein_int8_pc
# int6 probe
python eval/quantize.py --model skein-embed-6b --quant per_channel --bits 6 --calib 8192 --clip l2 --out /tmp/skein_int6
```
rachel: Quick summary: int8 PC R@10=0.81 (-0.02 vs fp16), silhouette=0.40; int6 R@10=0.74 (-0.09), silhouette=0.31. L2-normalize before retrieval recovered ~+0.018 for int8 and +0.03 for int6.
tom: Any centroid drift on finance/legal?
alice: Finance centroid shift mean cosine: int8 PC = -0.015, int6 = -0.045. Legal/ops small.
maya: Repro notes: microbatching (1/8/16) gave stable recall within +/-0.004; latency improvements at batch=16 for quantized. No KV-cache divergence. Filed a tokenizer edge-case for int6 on a small set (issue ML-809).
devops-bot: Canary scheduled: skein-embed-6b:int8-per-channel -> 2026-03-26T12:00:00Z. Will post status to #eng-ml.
tom: Rollout gates: block on daily R@10 drop >0.01 overall or any category >0.03. Require long-tail sweep K=1..100 and hard-negative stress.
rachel: I'll add the silhouette + mean-cosine checks to eval harness and codify alerts.
alice: Uploaded UMAP snapshots, recall tables, and short runbook to GS path. Will post final summary before canary.
maya: Thanks — good candidate.
